principals.name: I
principals.description: The Initiator: starts EDHOC, contributes its method, supported cipher suites, credential identifier and external authorization data, authenticates with its static Diffie-Hellman key, and verifies the Responder.

principals.name: R
principals.description: The Responder: processes message_1, contributes its supported cipher suites, credential identifier and external authorization data, authenticates with its static Diffie-Hellman key, and verifies the Initiator.

values.name: I
values.description: The Initiator's private static Diffie-Hellman authentication key (the document calls it I).

values.name: G_I
values.description: The Initiator's public static Diffie-Hellman authentication key, computed from I and contained in CRED_I. The document lets CRED_I be pre-provisioned to the Responder or transported in message_3 through ID_CRED_I, so the Responder is not assumed to store it beforehand.

values.name: R
values.description: The Responder's private static Diffie-Hellman authentication key (the document calls it R).

values.name: G_R
values.description: The Responder's public static Diffie-Hellman authentication key, computed from R and contained in CRED_R. The document lets CRED_R be pre-provisioned to the Initiator or transported in message_2 through ID_CRED_R, so the Initiator is not assumed to store it beforehand.

values.name: METHOD
values.description: The authentication method (signature or static DH for each side), agreed between Initiator and Responder out of band through the applicability statement.

values.name: SUITES_I
values.description: The cipher suites the Initiator supports, in order of preference.

values.name: SUITES_R
values.description: The cipher suites the Responder supports.

values.name: CRED_I
values.description: The Initiator's own authentication credential (certificate, CWT or CCS) containing G_I. The document lets it be pre-provisioned to the Responder or transported in message_3, so the Responder is not assumed to store it beforehand.

values.name: CRED_R
values.description: The Responder's own authentication credential (certificate, CWT or CCS) containing G_R. The document lets it be pre-provisioned to the Initiator or transported in message_2, so the Initiator is not assumed to store it beforehand.

values.name: ID_CRED_I
values.description: The Initiator's identifier of its own credential (e.g. kid or certificate hash), sent in message_3; it may also carry the credential itself.

values.name: ID_CRED_R
values.description: The Responder's identifier of its own credential (e.g. kid or certificate hash), sent in message_2; it may also carry the credential itself.
